title: Strong marker sets for arbitrary generating sets
summary: We prove the existence of clopen strong marker sets in $F(2^{\mathbb{Z}^n})$ for arbitrary finite generating sets. Specifically, for any positive integers $n, d_0\geq 1$ and any finite generating set $S\subseteq \mathbb{Z}^n$, we construct a clopen set $M\subseteq F(2^{\mathbb{Z}^n})$ and a positive integer $Δ$ such that (1) for any distinct $x,y\in M$ in the same orbit, $ρ(x,y)\geq d_0$; (2) for any $v\in S$ and any $x\in F(2^{\mathbb{Z}^n})$, there are non-negative integers $a,b\leq Δ$ such that $av\cdot x\in M$ and $-bv\cdot x\in M$.
